name: Ant
oneLiner: Data-dense enterprise clarity: consistent components, compact rows, and predictable interaction.

notes: The brand blue fails as small text on white at low weights; use the text role for copy and the accent for controls and links.
Row hover is a surface change, not a text change — keep the row's text contrast intact when it lightens.

sources.label: Palette and positioning authored for dsh-uiux; name from awesome-design-skills

primary.base: height: 32px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-accent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(5, 145, 255, 0.1)

default.base: height: 32px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem

text.base: height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-accent); font-size: 0.875rem

default.base: height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem
default.focusVisible: border-color: var(--uiux-color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(22, 119, 255, 0.2); outline: none

default.base: padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03), 0 1px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); font-size: 12px

header.base: height: 40px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left

do: Keep controls at 32px height and rows at 48px: this language is optimised for dense admin work.
Use the brand blue for primary actions and links only, never for large surfaces or headers.
Keep shadows under a 6px blur and pair them with a 1px border so edges stay crisp.
dont: Do not vary radii within one view; 6px for controls and 8px for containers, nothing else.
Do not animate table or form interactions longer than 200ms.
Do not stack a coloured button inside a coloured card.
antiPatterns: Gradient page headers over a data table.
Multiple primary buttons competing on one screen.
Body text set in pure black on white.
